stage: frozen before reading target source, commit body or repair diff
question: Does a one-revision direct __le-field consumer check produce reviewable evidence in other subsystems, and refuse unrelated or unsupported forms?
input_boundary: The detector receives only a selected parent commit and one changed C source path. It may follow at most two levels of quoted local includes within that same commit. It is not passed a fix revision or commit subject.

targets.role: different-subsystem endian candidate; exact mechanism unknown
different-subsystem endian candidate, possibly multi-cause; exact mechanism unknown
length/alignment scope control; exact mechanism unknown

predeclared_interpretation: candidate is a source-review lead for a direct typed __le field read in a supported host-style if condition; it is not a defect verdict. Multiple reads in one causal chain do not increase case count.
normal applies only to an analyzed read, such as endian-invariant zero comparison or explicit conversion. A path with zero findings is rule out-of-scope, not an overall clean revision.
Unsupported consumer syntax, unresolved declarations and ambiguous cases must remain insufficient or not observed; exceptions and absent selected source are runner_error, not a normal outcome.
Raw outputs and their hashes are saved before reading target commit body, diff or historical consumers for truth review. Later rule changes invalidate this holdout as independent evaluation.
Purposeful selection and model-short-decision history preclude population accuracy, recall or speedup claims.
